note: Rough Australian averages used when a place doesn't list its price. Reviewed monthly.
sources: Queensland national park camping fees from 1 July 2026: $7.75 per person per night (parks.qld.gov.au; confirmed by OzRoadTrips, Oct 2026)
Caravan park powered sites typically $40 to $80 a night (Jayco, May 2026) and $40 to $70 (OzRoadTrips, Oct 2026)
Motels $100 to $180, 3-star hotels $150 to $250, 4-star $200 to $350 a night (GMTC, Aug 2026)
Fuel late Oct 2026: diesel ~281c, unleaded ~236-240c, LPG ~116-123c (FuelRadar national average; NRMA weekly report 26 Oct 2026; myLPG.eu)
Fuel: live Google Maps prices along your route when available
NSW national park camping: six fee tiers per site from 1 July 2026, free (no facilities) to $54 off-peak (whatsupdownunder.com.au, 2026)
WA national park camping: $10 (no facilities), $15 (basic), $20 (showers) per adult per night (exploreparks.dbca.wa.gov.au, June 2026)
NT parks camping: Category B $10, Category A $15 per adult per night (nt.gov.au)
VIC, SA and TAS park camping: rough per-site estimates; check the parks booking site
